Text: Greetings, mortal. My servants tell me I can get my attire cleaned in this esteemed... establishment?
(Dry) Correct, I clean clothes.
(Bubbly) Yes, silly! Didn't you see the huge neon sign that says "Clean for the Mean"?
(Fresh) Nice, looks like word of my "esteemed establishment" got around.
Indeed. Would you be able to return this here shirt to it's original, pristine condition?
As you can see it is stained with blood.
(Dry) I'm in business with evil. Getting rid of blood is my bread and butter.
(Bubbly) Oh, that's a big one! The other guy didn't live to tell the tale, I imagine. Good on you!
(Fresh) Blood? That looks more like wine to me, Pookie.
It's a big stain and I can assure you it's blood. Blood indeed.
And wine at all...
I should know, I'm a vampire elder. Baronex Duskmantle of Midnight's Keep to be exact.
(Dry) It smells like wine, it looks like wine. I will treat it like wine.
(Bubbly) But it smells like... Oooh, got it. Of course dear Baronex, I will totally get rid of this BLOOD stain for you!
(Fresh) Whatever the stain, I'll make sure to get that shirt back on you asap.
I shall return to collect the garment tomorrow. I hope your services will please my sophisticated taste.
It's a big stain and I can assure you it's blood. Blood indeed.
My victim lost a lot of when I fed on them last night. I'm a vampire elder, you see.
Baronex Duskmantle of Midnight's Keep to be exact. Enchanté...
Pray do tell, have you ever worked for a vampire elder before? Most common folk find us most... frightning.
(Dry) Most my clientel is dangerous. I am confident my excellent services will keep me in business. And alive.
(Bubbly) A real vampire elder? I'm positively thrilled! But don't worry. I'm not scared. Most my clients are kinda dangerous.
(Fresh) I got many dangerous customers but none look as sharp as you. The bloodlust suits you well.
You are a gutsy one! Living here amongst such murderous creatures can't be easy.
Sometimes even a vampire can feel discouraged around such marvelous villainry.
Especially if this theoretical vampire was inept at hunting prey...
Which is not me, of course! I'm an exceptional hunterex! Confirmed by the blood stains on my shirt which are NOT wine at all.
I'm looking forward to collect my garment tomorrow. And to see you again, dear mortal.
